scripts.dev: node --eval "import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'; const run = args => spawn(process.execPath, args, { stdio: 'inherit' }); const s = run(['apps/server/src/index.ts']); const w = run(['node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js', 'apps/web']); const stop = () => { s.kill(); w.kill(); }; s.on('error', console.error); w.on('error', console.error); process.on('SIGINT', () => { stop(); process.exit(); }); process.on('SIGTERM', stop);"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build apps/web
